slides.title: Migration is 70% complete and on the original schedule
bullets: 14 of 20 services cut over
Zero customer-visible incidents this quarter
The remaining 6 services carry 80% of traffic
slides.visual: progress bar with all 20 services marked, the last 6 in a contrasting colour
slides.speaker_notes: We are at 70% with no customer impact. The remaining six services carry most of our traffic, so the last third is where the risk lives.

slides.title: Wins since the last report
bullets: Cut-over runbook reduced average migration time from 6 hours to 90 minutes
Two teams that were blocked on tooling are now self-serving
Rollback was exercised twice in production, both clean
slides.visual: before/after timeline of a single cut-over
slides.speaker_notes: The runbook change is the reason we caught up. Rollback has been tested for real, not on paper.

slides.title: Metrics dashboard
bullets: Availability 99.97% against a 99.95% target
p95 latency down 12% after the second cut-over
Error budget consumed: 41% of the quarter
slides.speaker_notes: Latency improved as a side effect of the new routing layer. Error budget is comfortable.

slides.title: Two issues are open
bullets: Service 15 has a schema dependency we cannot cut over until the billing team ships
On-call load is up 30% during cut-over weekends
slides.visual: table of the two issues with owner and age
slides.speaker_notes: Neither issue threatens the schedule yet. The billing dependency is the one to watch.

slides.title: The billing dependency is the schedule risk
bullets: Billing ships on 15 October, three weeks before our cut-over window
No buffer if that slips
Alternative path exists but costs two extra weeks of dual-write
slides.visual: dependency timeline with the two paths
slides.speaker_notes: If billing slips past 15 October, we choose between missing the quarter or paying for the dual-write path.

slides.title: Two decisions are needed today
bullets: Accept the 15 October dependency as the plan of record
Pre-approve the dual-write fallback budget
slides.visual: two decision cards with the owner of each
slides.speaker_notes: These are the only two things I need from this room.

slides.title: Next steps
bullets: Services 15-17 scheduled for weeks 1-3 of October
Load tests for the remaining six run in parallel
Weekly risk review with the billing lead starts Friday
slides.visual: three-lane schedule through the end of the quarter
slides.speaker_notes: The last three services are the ones that need the most rehearsal.

slides.title: Questions
bullets: Risks I have not listed

slides.speaker_notes: Open floor. I would rather hear the objection now than in November.
